newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shinhan Inv Bank completes $50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Shinhan Inv Bank completes $50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Shinhan Investment Bank's 364 days US$50 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been closed, said arranger Sumitomo Finance (Asia).
The certificates were issued at par to float at 45 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier manager is 53 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers are Sumitomo Finance (Asia), with US$6 million, and ING Barings, KDB Bank (UK) and WestLB Asia Pacific, with US$5 million each.

Co-lead managers are Bank Austria Hong Kong branch, Daiwa Securities (HK), Deutsche Siedlungs-und Landesrentenbank and Societe Generale Asia, with US$5 million each, and Vereins-und Westbank, with US$4 million.
Managers are CIBC Asia, with US$3 million, and Union Bank of Switzerland Hong Kong branch, with US$2 million.
Signing is set for December 17 in Hong Kong. The payment date is December 23.
